name: Kasumi Bar
description: A quiet, night-dark theme for a small reservation-first cocktail bar: a green-black ground, deep bottle-green panels, parchment type and fine antique-gold hairlines; Noto Serif Display over Josefin Sans. The bar's name and every chapter title are set in vertical type, and the menu runs down the right edge in vertical type (a compact menu button on phones). The home page is one sparse column: the name beside a candle-lit counter, tonight's seasonal drinks, the bar, the visit details and the journal. The menu card has fine gold dotted leaders, and the footer is a single hairline-gold line with the name, address, hours and a reservations link. With a menu, reservations, about, journal, newsletter and contact. The seasonal drinks, the menu card and the visit details (address, hours, reservation policy) are synced patterns, edited once.
